name: orchestrate-development
title_zh: 跨会话不丢线的开发总指挥，scope、状态
tagline_zh: 改到一半明天继续？多任务并行怕乱？它替你守住边界、记录每一步、最后验收才放行。不是聊天助手，是带着工牌的项目经理。
tagline_en: Resume a half-done refactor or juggle 5 tasks? It guards scope, logs state, and demands review before you call it.
desc_en: Use when a non-trivial software build, change, fix, debug, multi-session resume, or multi-task repository continuity need requires one orchestrator to preserve scope, authority, state, review, and verification; also use when explicitly requested for planning or review through this workflow. Do not use for simple Q&A, brainstorming, translation, summarization, lookup, or self-contained small tasks
why_zh: 别的 Agent 答完就跑，它把「改了什么、为什么改、下一步去哪」写成可查账本。
why_en: Unlike chat agents that forget, it keeps an auditable ledger of changes, rationale, and next steps, and blocks completion until.
limit_zh: 只认代码仓库里的实际改动，不认口头计划；需要你提供可执行命令或文件路径，否则它只会追问。不负责写代码，只负责编排。
limit_en: Works only on real repo changes, not verbal plans; needs executable commands or file paths or it just asks. It orchestrates, reviews, tracks—doesn't.
title_en: Dev orchestrator that keeps scope, state & review across.
